collocations: be excited about 对……感到兴奋 | get excited 变得兴奋
example: She was excited about her birthday party.

related.note: adj. 令人兴奋的（修饰物）

meaning: adj. 令人兴奋的；激动的
collocations: an exciting game 一场激动人心的比赛
example: The football match was very exciting.

collocations: advice on doing 做某事的建议 | give advice 给建议 | take/follow advice 接受建议
example: He gave me some advice on how to learn English.

related.note: v. 建议 advise doing / advise sb to do

collocations: suggest doing 建议做某事 | suggest that + (should) do
example: I suggest going there by bus.

related.note: v. 建议 advise sb to do sth

collocations: achieve one's goal 实现目标 | achieve success 获得成功
example: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.

collocations: decide to do 决定做 | decide on 决定选用 | make a decision 做决定
example: They decided to go on a trip.

related.note: n. 决定 make a decision

collocations: be successful in doing 成功做某事
example: He is a successful businessman.

related.note: v. 成功 succeed in doing

collocations: enjoy doing 喜欢做某事 | enjoy oneself 玩得开心
example: I enjoy reading books in the park.

collocations: prefer A to B 比起B更喜欢A | prefer doing to doing | prefer to do rather than do
example: I prefer reading to watching TV.

related.note: 宁愿 would rather do than do

collocations: imagine doing 想象做某事 | imagine sb doing
example: Can you imagine living without electricity?

collocations: practice doing 练习做某事 | put into practice 付诸实践
example: You need to practice speaking English every day.

collocations: allow sb to do 允许某人做 | be allowed to do 被允许做 | allow doing 允许做
example: My parents allow me to play basketball on weekends.

related.note: v. 允许 permit doing / permit sb to do

collocations: communicate with sb 与某人交流 | communicate sth to sb 把……传达给
example: It's important to communicate with your parents.

collocations: develop a habit 养成习惯 | develop into 发展成
example: Reading helps develop your mind.

collocations: consider doing 考虑做某事 | consider sb/sth as 认为……是
example: I'm considering changing my job.

collocations: have difficulty (in) doing 做某事有困难 | with difficulty 困难地
example: I have difficulty understanding this passage.

collocations: invent sth 发明某物
example: Bell invented the telephone.

collocations: prove to be 证明是 | prove that 证明……
example: The test proved that he was right.

collocations: regret doing 后悔做过 | regret to say 遗憾地说
example: I regret not studying harder for the exam.

collocations: used to do 过去常常做 | be used to doing 习惯做 | be used to do 被用来做
example: I used to play basketball, but now I am used to running.
